search_scope: Opened current CDE standards, direct mathematics framework PDF, CAST version 3.0 guidance/update page, CDE MTSS page, WWC recommendation pages and current publication index. This was a focused artifact review, not a systematic literature review.
access_limits: CDE mathematics-framework and all-frameworks landing pages encountered redirect/bot-check errors on some retrievals; the official chapter 6 PDF was successfully opened and the relevant printed pages were read. No blocked page was treated as full-text verification.
No adopted curriculum, local pacing document, individual student support plan, or student work was supplied.

sources.title: California Content Standards: 3.MD.5.a
sources.date_version: Current CDE standards portal; publication date not displayed
sources.section: Standard text and grade; web lines 21–36
sources.supported_claim: A unit square defines one square unit of area.
sources.evidence_type: Official student standard, not a research effect estimate
sources.limits: Defines intended content; does not validate a task or measure a learner.

sources.title: California Content Standards: 3.MD.7.b
sources.date_version: Current CDE standards portal; publication date not displayed
sources.section: Standard text and grade; web lines 21–35
sources.supported_claim: Whole-number rectangle side lengths can be multiplied to find area; the corrected task samples this demand.
sources.limits: The short task does not cover all contexts or establish full-standard mastery.

sources.title: California Content Standards: 3.MD.8
sources.date_version: Current CDE standards portal; publication date not displayed
sources.supported_claim: Perimeter is linear measure; the standard includes known-side perimeter and rectangles with the same area and different perimeters.
sources.limits: The initial ticket omits unknown-side problems and other portions of the standard.

sources.title: 2023 Mathematics Framework, Chapter 6: Mathematics—Investigating and Connecting, Transitional Kindergarten Through Grade Five
sources.section: Printed pp. 83–85; square tiles, linear perimeter, geometric volume
sources.supported_claim: Connect square coverage to rectangle area and contrast this with outside boundary length; geometric volume of rectangular prisms is discussed for grade 5.
sources.population_setting: California TK–5; selected material concerns grades 3–5
sources.limits: Guidance supports the representation choice but does not establish efficacy of the authored exit ticket.

sources.title: Use multiple media for communication, UDL Guidelines 3.0, consideration 5.1
sources.supported_claim: Vary expression modes when a specific medium is not integral to the goal.
sources.population_setting: Learners with varied communication needs; general educational settings
sources.limits: Not a causal study or a claim that every specific adaptation preserves every construct; here the target is mathematics rather than handwriting.

sources.title: Multi-Tiered System of Supports
sources.supported_claim: MTSS uses data, problem-solving teams, aligned supports, and continuous improvement.
sources.limits: Does not provide a one-question diagnostic or automatic tier-placement rule; this review is not a special-education eligibility or legal review.

sources.title: Using Student Achievement Data to Support Instructional Decision Making
sources.issuer: IES / What Works Clearinghouse; Hamilton et al.
sources.supported_claim: Use data in an ongoing instructional-improvement cycle.
sources.evidence_type: Practice guide; recommendation 1 rated Minimal Evidence
sources.population_setting: School educators; grade 3 is among the guide's listed grades
sources.limits: Does not prescribe this ticket, a mastery threshold, or the exact timing and decision rules authored here; not an ESSA tier or study-design rating.

sources.title: Assisting Students Struggling with Mathematics: Intervention in the Elementary Grades
sources.issuer: IES / What Works Clearinghouse; Fuchs et al.
sources.supported_claim: Clear mathematical language and well-chosen concrete/semi-concrete representations are supported intervention practices.
sources.evidence_type: Practice guide; recommendations 2 and 3 each rated Strong Evidence
sources.population_setting: Elementary mathematics intervention; listed grades K–6
sources.limits: The rating belongs to each recommendation, not to this brief authored lesson or assessment. No intervention dosage efficacy is claimed.

sources.title: California Content Standards: 3.MD.2
sources.date_version: Current CDE standards portal; publication date not displayed

sources.supported_claim: Grade 3 includes liquid-volume measurement and excludes geometric container volume in this standard.
sources.limits: The original word volume is underspecified; this source does not establish the class's intended next lesson or readiness.

sources.title: California Content Standards: 3.MD.7.a
sources.date_version: Current CDE standards portal; publication date not displayed
